calculation.accreditationStatus: The accreditation’s status today makes no difference. A load with no usable date, or dated outside the months shown, is not counted.
calculation.columns: The columns run from January of the reporting year to the last complete month. Each column is that month’s own figure. The total adds the months together.

countedIf.accreditationValid: the accreditation was valid, and not suspended or cancelled, on that date
countedIf.fieldsComplete: its waste balance fields are complete
countedIf.leadIn: A load is only counted if:

exportedNotCountedIf.leadIn: Exported waste is also not counted if:
exportedNotCountedIf.notValidOnExportDate: the accreditation was not valid on the date of export
exportedNotCountedIf.siteNotApproved: the overseas site was not approved for the exporter on the date of export

calculation.figure: Each figure is the tonnage credited to accredited operators’ waste balances for that material and accreditation type in that month, less the tonnage sent on.
calculation.heading: How the figures are calculated
calculation.live: The figures are live. They are calculated from the reports held at the time shown above, not from a record of what was published, so a resubmission changes earlier months.

monthCounted.exported: an overseas reprocessor received the exported waste
monthCounted.leadIn: A load is counted in the month:
monthCounted.product: a recycled product left the reprocessing site
monthCounted.received: a reprocessor received it for reprocessing

calculation.notesNotDeducted: PRNs and PERNs issued through the service are not deducted. The figures include tonnage on which notes have already been issued.
calculation.prnIssued: Waste received for reprocessing or exported is not counted if a PRN or PERN was reported as issued on it.
calculation.product: A recycled product is not counted unless its weight was added to the waste balance.
calculation.sentOn: Sent-on loads are deducted in the month they left the site. They are only deducted for a reprocessor credited on the tonnage it receives, and are deducted whether or not the accreditation was valid on that date.
calculation.submissions: The figures are calculated from the latest summary log each accreditation has submitted. A resubmission replaces the earlier one. Registered-only operators are not included.
